target_customer: Experienced retail and active crypto traders who want a fast desktop trading terminal
problem: Professional-grade trading tools from traditional finance were not available to crypto traders, who juggled fragmented apps for tracking, analysis and order management.
business_model: Desktop trading terminal sold by subscription, made free of charge in June 2022

founders.name: Amar Gautam
founders.background_notes: YC page: over a decade at TPICAP as Trading API Specialist and Tech Lead. A September 2021 TechBullion interview says he graduated in 2006 in computer science and engineering and left his job in 2018 to work on HyperLinq full time.

founders.name: Kunal Kumar
founders.background_notes: From the YC page. A June 2022 press release gives his title as CTO.

technical_complexity.rationale: A native desktop terminal for Mac, Windows and Linux needing low latency order execution, real-time position streams and secure key handling across many exchange APIs; standard but demanding engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Terminals are copyable and exchanges and charting vendors can add similar features; speed and workflow polish are the only edge, and the company later gave the product away free.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent action found. The company made all features free in June 2022.

market_need_then: Crypto trading volume and retail participation were high in 2021, and the founders argue crypto traders lacked tools that exist in traditional finance, per the September 2021 TechBullion interview.

branding.domain_note: Product site is gethypertrader.com, a prefixed domain; company was legally HyperLinq and shipped the product as HyperTrader.

identity.voice_and_tone: Speed and efficiency messaging: fewer clicks, fast execution, real-time updates.

branding.community_and_virality: Listed on Product Hunt and a NexusFi platforms forum; a similarly named Hypertrade app causes name confusion.

brand_strength.rationale: Descriptive and confusable name, split between HyperLinq and HyperTrader, with little press about the brand itself.

outcome_analysis: HyperTrader is listed as active. After a Launch HN post in August 2021 it moved to free access in June 2022, which suggests monetization difficulty in a crowded field of exchanges and charting tools. No exit or shutdown was found, and no priced round could be sourced, so traction and runway are unknown. Founder experience in trading systems is a strength, but the outcome cannot be judged from public data.
notes: gethypertrader.com could not be fetched (DNS failure), so the site may be dead or blocked; not worked around. Funding unverified and conflicting across aggregators ($125K pre-seed on Seedtable, $1.4M total on VCBacked, $1.55M on Signalbase, $500K on CB Insights), none confirmed by a primary source, so no rounds recorded.
